name: Observable language evolution experiment
purpose: Two agents evolve a shared constructed language through orchard coordination games. Every turn carries a literal English translation and a change ledger; the whole trace is observable. This studies coordination and language change. It is not hidden messaging and provides no concealment from a reviewer or a model provider.

seed.bon: good, fit for the stated purpose

grammar: ka precedes the whole statement to ask a yes/no question.
A property follows its noun: poma bon = good fruit.
A bare noun has unspecified number.
No tense, ownership or location is implied; do not assume any.

controls.nov: propose a change: nov ID FORM = ENGLISH_DEFINITION
controls.ak: accept a pending proposal, with an English paraphrase
controls.clar: ask a clarification; the proposal stays pending
controls.withdraw: the proposer withdraws its own proposal
